regime_context: The Hong Kong detector shows a narrow, non-directional rotation: only 4 of 17 themes are eligible under the absolute-trend gate, with Banks (H + HK) the lone clear leader and Diversified Miners a close challenger with a thin 0.103 margin. Gate_helps is true for this market, so the trend discipline has historically cut drawdown/shake-out here, but cross-sectional momentum rank-IC remains ~0 — this is a focus lens, not a return forecast. Nearly all themes are unscorable (no ETF proxy), so falsifiable theses are constrained to the single scorable theme.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the Banks + Miners leadership margin (0.103) continues to widen or collapses: if the challenger Diversified Miners closes the score gap to Banks (H + HK) and ALSO becomes eligible under the absolute-trend gate (it is currently eligible=false despite rank 2), the leadership handoff would be confirmed and the watch retires.

theses.subject: China Tech & Internet
theses.thesis: China Tech & Internet is the lowest-ranked scorable theme (rank 13/17, score -0.635), ineligible under the absolute-trend gate, with a low durability_bar (0.18), mean-revert Hurst tag, and negative breadth (0.053). The gate_helps=true backtest says avoiding below-gate names is the ONE validated edge on this market — staying away from ineligible themes is a de-risk lean, not a return call. I am leaning underweight on the only proxy I can mark (3033.HK) because the trend gate places this name outside the tradable universe.
theses.dissent: Mean-revert Hurst tag on a deeply washed-out theme (crowding_z -0.69, score near bottom) means a sharp reflex bounce is possible; the theme is already far from highs and oversold, and 3033.HK may not represent the full breadth of the theme. Underweight on an already-beaten-down proxy can mean missing a snapback.
